sources.title: About Bench — Operating Today as an Employer.com Company
paragraphs: Bench is an online bookkeeping service for U.S.-based businesses, small and growing — operating today as an Employer.com company.
We started Bench to take bookkeeping off business owners' plates for good — so you can spend your time running your business, not reconciling it.
Here's a quick timeline of where Bench has been, and where things stand today.
Bench has helped business owners get their books done by real bookkeepers, backed by software — for over a decade.
Bench is fully operational, staffed by its in-house team, with Employer.com continuing to invest in the bookkeeping business.
Same model, same team, doing the work we've always done — now with the backing to keep doing it.

Bench uses read-only access to your financial accounts — your transactions can be imported for bookkeeping, but no one can move your money. Every bookkeeper passes background checks, and you can export your completed work anytime, even after your subscription ends.
A dedicated bookkeeper and simple software, working today. Take a look.
